camel_example: aliyun dts TransferInstanceClass --region cn-hangzhou --OrderType UPGRADE --DtsJobId 'r4yr723m199****' --InstanceClass large --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
description_en: Upgrades the specifications of a DTS instance
description_zh: 调用TransferInstanceClass可以升级DTS实例规格
kebab_example: aliyun dts transfer-instance-class --order-type UPGRADE --instance-class large --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --dts-job-id 'r4yr723m199****' --region cn-hangzhou
name: TransferInstanceClass

parameters.help_en: The order type. Set the value to UPGRADE
parameters.name: order_type

parameters.help_en:
The instance specifications after the upgrade. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/208925.html operation to query the instance specifications before the upgrade.

For more information about the supported specifications and the upper limit of performance (RPS), see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26606.html and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26605.html
parameters.help_zh:
升级后的实例规格，可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/208925.html查询升级前的实例规格。

支持的规格和性能上限（RPS）参考，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26606.html和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26605.html
parameters.name: instance_class

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the DTS instance. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data migration or synchronization task. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html operation to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: 迁移或同步任务ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html查询
parameters.name: dts_job_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The number of subtasks for the destination ApsaraDB for Redis Cluster Edition instance. This parameter is used only to upgrade or downgrade the number of Redis subtasks. Valid values: 1 to 64. When you upgrade the configuration, the value must be greater than the current number and cannot exceed the number of shards in the source. When you downgrade the configuration, the value must be less than the current number
parameters.help_zh: 目标 Redis 集群版的子任务数量，仅用于 Redis 子任务数量的升配或降配，取值范围为 1～64。升配时须大于当前数量且不超过源端分片数，降配时须小于当前数量
parameters.name: database_count

ChargeType.description_en:
The billing method. Valid values:
POSTPAY: pay-as-you-go.
PREPAY: subscription
ChargeType.description_zh:
付费类型，返回值：
POSTPAY：按量付费（后付费）。
PREPAY：包年包月（预付费）

DtsJobId.description_en: The ID of the data migration or synchronization task

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic error message, which is used to replace %s in the error message returned in the ErrMessage parameter.

If ErrMessage returns The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid and DynamicMessage returns DtsJobId, the specified DtsJobId request parameter is invalid
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的%s。

如果ErrMessage返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage返回DtsJobId，则表示所传入的请求参数DtsJobId不合法

EndTime.description_en:
The time when the instance expires.

This parameter is returned only when the ChargeType parameter is set to PREPAY
EndTime.description_zh:
实例到期时间。

ChargeType为PREPAY，才会返回此参数

ErrCode.description_en: The error code returned if the request fails
ErrCode.description_zh: 调用出错时返回的错误码

ErrMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the request fails
ErrMessage.description_zh: 调用错误时返回对应的错误信息
ErrMessage.example: The request processing has failed due to some unknown error.

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。返回值：

true：请求成功。
false：请求失败
